pairs: What's the permission that allows creating provisioning profiles in Apple Developer account is called?

The permission that allows creating provisioning profiles in an Apple Developer account is called 'Provisioning Profile Administrator.' This role enables you to manage and create profiles essential for signing your apps before submitting them to the App Store. For more information, visit [Apple Developer Documentation on Provisioning Profile Permissions](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appstoreconnectapi/provisioning_profiles).
